run_when: When the employee count from the list is missing, or a team page was found.

prompt.task: Estimate headcount and assign exactly one segment: SMB (1 to 5 employees), MM (6 to 25), ENT (26 or more).
prompt.definition: Estimate from the team or about page, the number of distinct people named across the site, and the size of the careers page. On a boundary, assign the lower band. When headcount can't be determined, default to SMB.
watch_out_for: Don't assign ENT for a polished website, a broad product or an enterprise customer list; only for evidence of 26+ people
About seven in ten best-fit customers have five employees or fewer

evidence_quote.description: Exact words copied from the text. Empty when the answer is unknown.

source.description: Page name or URL the quote came from.

reason.description: One plain sentence explaining the answer.

output.reason: Four people are shown, so SMB.
